scripts.dev:all: npx -y concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
